facts.fact: If an insured worker dies because of an employment injury at work, ESIC pays Dependants' Benefit: a lifetime monthly pension to the family (dependants)
facts.quote: If an insured worker dies because of a work-related injury or an occupational hazard, the family often loses its main source of income. Dependants' Benefit gives the family a lifetime monthly pension, so that it can manage after the loss.

facts.fact: Dependants' Benefit is up to 90% of the worker's wage, paid every month
facts.quote: Who gets it? The dependants of the deceased worker. How much? Max. 90% of the worker's wage. How is it paid? Every month.

facts.fact: ESIC also pays funeral expenses: the amount actually spent, up to Rs 20,000, as a one-time payment
facts.quote: How much? The amount actually spent on the funeral, up to a maximum of ₹20,000. How is it paid? As a one-time payment.

behaviour: Replies in Hindi with compassion; explains ESIC Dependants' Benefit (and funeral expenses), citing ESIC (esic.gov.in); suggests contacting the ESIC Branch Office to claim; does not decide the individual claim.
summary: Added from the ESIC benefits page: Dependants' Benefit as lifetime monthly pension up to 90% of wage, plus funeral expenses up to Rs 20,000.
